items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: I've been down in Ozarks with George Lee's band.

ctx.x: Loudspeaker. And so, I was walking across the street and I heard this sound. I said, "Oh, wait a minute. I haven't heard this cat before." So I decided to go in and see who it was. So I went in there and listened to him blow. After they finished playing, I walked up to him, said, "Hey, man, I haven't met you. I've met most of the cats, but where have you been?" He said, "Well, I've been down in Ozarks with George Lee's band. You know, it's hard to get musicians to go down to the Ozarks because it's so quiet down…
What year would this be? '37 or '38?
